build_mesh_vae_autoencoder: build a Mesh VAE AutoEncoder with encoder, decoder, shadow net, and face decoder for drivable human mesh reconstruction
run_autoencoder_forward: run the AutoEncoder forward pass with lbs_motion, camera positions, and optional geometry to reconstruct mesh and texture
encode_mesh_geometry: encode posed mesh geometry and face embeddings into latent codes using the AutoEncoder encode method
create_conv_decoder: create a ConvDecoder that decodes pose, body embeddings, and face embeddings into geometry deltas and texture maps
build_face_encoder: build a FaceEncoder that encodes face geometry and texture into latent face embeddings with VAE noise
